members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id, used as the rail's value.

members.name: title
members.doc: Card title, shown on the closed card's label and in the open preview.

members.name: eyebrow
members.doc: Short line above the title: a category, a place, a date.

members.name: description
members.doc: One or two sentences shown only while the card is open.

members.name: meta
members.doc: Detail shown at the bottom of the preview, such as a duration or a count.

members.name: image
members.doc: Image URL for the card background.

members.name: alt
members.doc: Alternative text for the image. Leave empty when the title already says it.

types.name: PreviewRailProps
types.doc: A rail of cards in which one is open: the hovered or focused card widens to show its preview while the others shrink to a slice. In a narrow container the rail turns into a column and the open card grows taller instead.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Open card when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first one.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Called when the open card is pressed (click, tap, Enter or Space).

members.name: trigger
members.doc: What opens a card with a mouse: hovering it, or only pressing it. Keyboard focus and taps always open.

members.name: ratio
members.doc: How many times wider the open card is than a closed one.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the outer element.
